description: COCO-Bridge 2021+ Dataset is a data set deposited in vt.vtechdata by its authors Eric Bianchi, Matthew Hebdon. This is a dataset of structural bridge details, submitted as an extension to COCO-Bridge (Bianchi, 2021) (https://doi.org/10.7294/m8pg-4a02). There are four structural bridge details labeled in this dataset: [bearings, cover plate terminations, gusset plate connections, and out of plane stiffeners]. The dataset contains 1470 annotated structural bridge images with the respective csv, txt, and xml files. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 679945383 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
